notes: The installed VST3 was identified by exact vendor and class ID; its Amount and Speed parameter IDs were read from that binary.
Spoton exposes twelve note toggles rather than one canonical key and one canonical scale parameter, so key/scale translation needs a dedicated adapter.
No humanize parameter was observed. MeeWav must not display a working Humanisation control for Spoton until a real mapping exists.
Synthetic processing proves execution, not audible pitch-correction quality, microphone monitoring stability or Room publication.
The plugin may enter the verified local registry, but it must stay unavailable in the user selector until the adapter and audio-plane gates pass.
